verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any SharePoint capability for scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. Webhooks are event-driven notifications, not time-based schedules. Community mentions of 'workflows' and 'flows' describe one-off or event-based automations, and those flows come from a separate product (Power Automate), not a documented recurring scheduler in SharePoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
